name: Fujimura Keisuke
source:
Looks indecisive and timidly, and so he is.
Enclosured by wife and daughters with strong personality, with tears from his eyes, tries his best as house-husband.
There are great numbers of people feeling envious about his life with beautiful wife and daughters. But knowing the true state of affairs, everyone surely will feel compassion for this man.
